name: schema.org JobPosting
description: Extracts the schema.org JobPosting JSON-LD block that most ATS platforms (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, LinkedIn, Indeed, and many company career pages) embed in job page HTML for SEO, and normalizes it into Jobflo jobs. Paste a job page's HTML source and it works across virtually any site that follows the standard, with no per-site scraping logic.
author: jsrothwell
